prerequisites: Skills acquired in previous modules of the master's degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Utilize Systems Engineering to study and understand reality, with the purpose of implementing or optimizing complex systems.
Design, manage, and implement complex engineering systems throughout their life cycle.
Perform system or process engineering based on its inputs and outputs, including requirements analysis, functional analysis, risk analysis, verification, trade-offs, and synthesis.

assessment_rules: To pass the course, a minimum grade of 5 out of 10 is mandatory for both the theoretical exam (EX) and the main project (TP). If these minimums are met, the final grade is calculated as 0.20 * EX + 0.80 * (TP + TA). Otherwise, the final grade will be the minimum between the calculated grade and 4.0. Grades from EX, TP, and TA are retained for all calls of the academic year. Students may submit alternative assignments for the extraordinary call if requested.
